name: Denta
long_description:
Denta is the practice management platform that puts dental practices on autopilot. When a dentist starts a new practice, instead of finding an accounting firm, hiring two front desk workers, and then spending their nights posting insurance payments, they use Denta.

I started Denta to help operate my Dad's 10 practices in Iowa. In supporting those, I realized the most painful part was both people and agents having messy access to fragmented data.

I standardized that, launched two weeks ago, have $3,000 in monthly revenue, and am piloting 60 practices on Denta.
one_liner: The dental practice that runs itself
